title: Cavern of the Patriarchs
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Cavern of the Patriarchs exterior:massive buff-stone enclosure with shallow upper pilasters/coping/rounded crenellations,two square corner minarets with paired lights/corbelled galleries/open upper pavilions/faceted caps,independent mapped prayer and attached ranges/three small caps,selected closed entry fields and threshold landings. Four existing shared256² ashlar/sandstone/painted-metal/wood graphs,five merged groups,four browser levels. Earlier exact complex outline,current identity POI and nine current building/part polygons retained separately. All untagged heights and architectural subplans are picture estimates;subterranean caves/interiors/current finish and exact terrain/threshold joins omitted or unverified.
